messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Media, POLITICS, Political behaviour and attitudes, and Government, political systems and organisations in Germany during the 2010s, matching this research need: survey data on opinions about Germany’s current situation, trust in democracy and politics, views of parties and politicians, political participation, and media use
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS Politbarometer 2010 2019 dataset political attitudes media use Germany
German Longitudinal Election Study GLES 2013 2017 cross section media use political trust dataset
ALLBUS 2018 Germany political trust democracy media use dataset GESIS
European Social Survey Germany 2010 2018 political trust media use dataset
action.query: GESIS Politbarometer 2010 2019 dataset political attitudes media use Germany

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Politbarometer Germany – Annual Surveys and Cumulative Datasets (2010–2019)","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/elections/politbarometer","justification":"Excellent match. Politbarometer provides approximately monthly representative surveys of German voters, covering assessments of Germany's current political and economic situation, satisfaction with democracy, political interest, party preferences, evaluations of politicians, government performance, voting intentions, and major political issues. Annual cumulative datasets are available throughout the 2010s, making this particularly useful for studying changes in political attitudes over time."},{"title":"Politbarometer 1977–2024 – Partial Cumulative Dataset","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA2391","justification":"Highly relevant longitudinal survey dataset containing harmonized political opinion measures across multiple decades, including 2010–2019. Covers political attitudes, party preferences, evaluations of government and politicians, satisfaction with democracy, and perceptions of Germany's economic and political circumstances. Particularly suitable for examining trends in public opinion during the 2010s."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Election Surveys and Panels, 2009–2017","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/data-and-documentation","justification":"Excellent match for research on political behavior, democratic attitudes, party evaluations, political participation, and political communication in Germany. Includes cross-sectional surveys, longitudinal panels, campaign surveys, and tracking studies covering the 2013 and 2017 federal elections. Relevant variables include political interest, voting behavior, evaluations of parties and candidates, perceptions of political problems, and media-related political communication. Multiple datasets allow comparisons across elections and over time."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Cross-Sectional Election Surveys","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gles/overview","justification":"Highly relevant survey series examining German voters before and after federal elections, including those held in 2013 and 2017. Captures political preferences, evaluations of parties and politicians, political attitudes, electoral participation, and political involvement. Particularly useful for investigating how public perceptions of politics and democratic representation relate to electoral behavior."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – Surveys from 2010 to 2018","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/allbus/data-and-documentation","justification":"Strong match for studying political and social attitudes among the German population throughout the 2010s. ALLBUS conducts representative population surveys approximately every two years. Relevant measures include political interest, political orientations, trust in institutions, attitudes toward democracy, social values, and civic engagement. The repeated cross-sectional design supports comparisons of attitudes across different years and demographic groups."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – Cumulative Dataset","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/allbus","justification":"Useful for longitudinal analysis of political attitudes and social change in Germany, including observations collected during the 2010s. The cumulative datasets combine multiple ALLBUS survey waves and facilitate comparisons of political trust, institutional confidence, political interest, democratic values, and participation patterns. Particularly appropriate for identifying long-term changes in Germans' relationships with democratic institutions."},{"title":"GLES – German Federal Election Studies, Campaign Panels and Media Data","url_or_doi":"https://gles.eu/daten/","justification":"Especially relevant for research combining political behavior and media use. The GLES collection includes election campaign panels, rolling cross-sectional surveys, tracking surveys, and media content data associated with German federal elections in 2009, 2013, and 2017. These resources support research on political information exposure, election campaigns, political preferences, evaluations of candidates, voting decisions, and changes in public opinion."},{"title":"Modern State and Living Democracy (Moderner Staat und lebendige Demokratie), 2016","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12786","justification":"Relevant Germany-specific survey dataset collected in October 2016. Classified under political behavior and attitudes and government, political systems, and organizations. Its focus on the modern state and democracy makes it a potentially useful supplementary source for investigating public attitudes toward democratic governance and political institutions during the 2010s. The documentation should be checked for the precise questions available."},{"title":"European Social Survey (ESS) – Germany, 2010–2018","url_or_doi":"https://www.europeansocialsurvey.org/data/","justification":"Strong supplementary source for representative survey data on Germany during the 2010s. Relevant ESS rounds include 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018. Core questionnaires cover trust in political institutions, satisfaction with democracy, political interest, voting behavior, political participation, political ideology, and media use. Particularly valuable for examining German public opinion over time and comparing Germany with other European democracies."},{"title":"GESIS Election Studies – German Political Opinion and Electoral Behavior Data","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/services/finding-and-accessing-data/election-studies","justification":"Relevant repository entry point for German political survey datasets, including Politbarometer and the German Longitudinal Election Study. Provides access to studies covering political attitudes, electoral behavior, party evaluations, evaluations of politicians, and public responses to political developments during the 2010s. Useful for identifying additional survey waves and specialized election-related datasets."},{"title":"GESIS Politbarometer Research Data Collection","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/?study_group=Politbarometer&type=research_data","justification":"Direct research-data catalog for individual and cumulative Politbarometer datasets, including surveys from 2010–2019. Particularly relevant variables include perceptions of Germany's most important problems, satisfaction with democracy, assessments of the national economy, confidence in political leadership, party sympathy ratings, politician evaluations, political interest, and voting intentions. The catalog allows researchers to identify specific survey years and examine detailed variable documentation."}]}
